text: The US Department of Labor's Wage and Hour Division found that Perdue Farms jointly employed children in hazardous occupations at its Accomac, Virginia poultry processing plant; Perdue agreed to pay $4 million in restitution and a $150,000 civil penalty.
short: US Labor Department found child-labor violations at Perdue's Accomac, Va. plant; $4M restitution, $150K penalty.

source.name: U.S. Department of Labor: US Department of Labor reaches agreement with Perdue Farms, secures judgment against staffing agency to address child labor violations
